title: Correlated expectation and the noise operator
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f,g:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. If $(X,Y)$ is sampled by choosing $X$ uniformly from $\{\pm1\}^n$ and then independently retaining each coordinate of $X$ in $Y$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise, then $\mathbb E[f(X)g(Y)]=\langle f,T_\rho g\rangle$, where $T_\rho$ is the noise operator and the inner product is uniform on the cube.
